faq_heading: Homes near Coast Meridian Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Coast Meridian Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Coast Meridian Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Coast Meridian Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Coast Meridian Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are William Watson Elementary (1.0 km south-west), Gobind Sarvar School (1.2 km north) and Walnut Road Elementary (1.4 km west).

How the Coast Meridian Elementary search works

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Coast Meridian Elementary

11 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Coast Meridian Elementary in a straight line (7 elementary, 2 other, 2 secondary; 4 independent). The closest is William Watson Elementary, 1.0 km away, and the farthest on this list is Serpentine Heights Elementary, 2.7 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Holy Cross Regional High School (1.9 km); the nearest independent school is Gobind Sarvar School (1.2 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Frost Road Elementary (1.5 km). Other elementary schools close by: William Watson Elementary (1.0 km south-west), Walnut Road Elementary (1.4 km west), Frost Road Elementary (1.5 km north-west), St Matthew's Elementary (2.0 km north-west), Coyote Creek Elementary (2.6 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is William Watson Elementary, 1.0 km south-west of Coast Meridian Elementary.
